definitions.explanation: The row closest to the stage, screen, or front of a venue. Used for seating at concerts, theaters, classrooms, and similar settings.

examples.japanese: {最前列|さいぜんれつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{席|せき}→席：02215_seki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{取|と}れた→取れる：02376_toreru⟧。
{最前列|さいぜんれつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{座|すわ}る→座る：00757_suwaru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{役者|やくしゃ}→役者：05113_yakusha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{表情|ひょうじょう}→表情：03585_hyoujou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{見|み}える→見える：01165_mieru⟧。
examples.english: If you sit in the front row, you can clearly see the actors' expressions.

examples.japanese: ⟦コンサート→コンサート：01360_konsaato⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{最前列|さいぜんれつ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}く→高い：00500_takai⟧、⟦チケット→チケット：11014_chiketto⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{売|う}り{切|き}れる→売り切れる：03012_urikireru⟧。
examples.english: Front-row seats at concerts are very popular, and tickets sell out immediately.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{最|さい}→最〜：03954_sai⟧ (most/very) + ⟦{前列|ぜんれつ}→前列：20217_zenretsu⟧ (front row). Refers to the very first row in a seating arrangement.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {最前列|さいぜんれつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{席|せき}→席：02215_seki⟧: front-row seat
- {最前列|さいぜんれつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{座|すわ}る→座る：00757_suwaru⟧: to sit in the front row
- {最前列|さいぜんれつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{並|なら}ぶ→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧: to stand/line up in the front row

FORMS:
Follows the ⟦{最|さい}→最〜：03954_sai⟧ + location pattern:
- {最前列|さいぜんれつ}: front row
- {最後列|さいこうれつ}: last/back row
- ⟦{最前線|さいぜんせん}→最前線：13057_saizensen⟧: front line (military/figurative)

USAGE:
Commonly used for concerts, theaters, classrooms, and sports venues. Front-row seats are often premium-priced or highly sought after.
